explanation: The gene report's differential-expression table now leads with every track at raw p < 0.05: FDR survivors by q, then nominal tracks (FDR fails) by p, each labelled under its q (FDR < 0.05 or p < 0.05 only), the q itself named in the cell because the column headers are screen-reader only with a data-tier attribute, and nominal rows show their p beside log2FC uncoloured. Area captions, the verdict, the notes, the quiet-area line and the Show-all toggle name the nominal tier; significant counts, directions and colours still follow the FDR call, and the report contract and routes are unchanged.
